// diagnostic

E0413

`priv` on a non-module declaration; `priv` marks only modules and fields

What

`priv` on a non-module declaration; `priv` marks only modules and fields

Why

Privacy is a property of a module or a field, never of a single declaration

Fix

Delete `priv`; move the declaration into a `priv module` if it must stay internal.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0413: tests/ui/vis_priv_declaration.stderr.

Error [jet.PrivNotAllowed]: `priv` marks only modules and fields
  --> tests/ui/vis_priv_declaration.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | priv fn helper() -> Int { 1 }
    | ^^^^
 Why: Declarations are public by default; privacy belongs to a `priv module` or a `priv` field
 Fix: Delete `priv`; move the declaration into a `priv module` if it must stay internal
